Adult guild members at an isekai frontier guild review quests and passage permits before the seasonal caravan departs. The members stand beside a desk with route records while loaded wagons wait beyond the doorway. One member places a permit beside the route map with a hand resting on the desk edge. Soft doorway light falls across the paperwork and nearby wagon wheels. The frame gives the permit review priority while keeping the waiting caravan legible.

candidates.interpreted_meaning: A guarded commercial departure from a biaoju loading yard or gate onto a continuous road. Sealed boxes or bundled cargo visibly load a cart, pack animal, or coherent transport unit; adult martial escorts distribute around that owned load and orient along its route. The cargo-protection relation, not readable signage or costume alone, separates the scene from an army convoy, merchant-only caravan, adventuring party, empty courtyard, or generic wagon.
